name: HEC Provision of Higher Education Opportunities for Students of Balochistan & Erstwhile FATA
name_ur: بلوچستان اور سابقہ فاٹا کے طلباء کے لیے اعلیٰ تعلیمی وظیفہ
target_group: Undergraduate students with Balochistan or erstwhile FATA domicile
summary_en: A fully/partially funded undergraduate scholarship reserved for students with Balochistan or erstwhile FATA domicile, covering tuition and, in many cycles, a stipend.
summary_ur: بلوچستان یا سابقہ فاٹا کے ڈومیسائل رکھنے والے طلباء کے لیے انڈرگریجویٹ اسکالرشپ، ٹیوشن فیس اور وظیفہ شامل۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Female applicants and applicants from remote/under-served districts are often prioritized in scoring - check the current cycle's advertisement.

required_documents: Admission letter/proof of enrollment in a partner institution
Income statement (if requested in the current cycle)
application_steps: Confirm the current admission cycle is open on the HEC website
Secure admission in an HEC-recognized partner institution/program
Prepare all required documents listed above
Submit application through the HEC portal or the designated institutional focal point (varies by cycle)
Track application status and respond to any HEC follow-up requests before the stated deadline
disclaimer: Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.
